contract: official := check1 OR check2.satisfied; check2.satisfied := check2_present AND check2_identity_bound (a verification mark present but NOT identity-bound to the company is NOT check2, and resolves exactly as if no mark were present); check3 (bio/domain match) NEVER admits on its own and only strengthens a result that already carries check1 or a satisfied check2. check1 alone is sufficient (the company's own web presence already establishes its identity).
denominator_basis: 2 (check1) x 2 (check2_present) x 2 (check2_identity_bound) x 2 (check3) = 16, full cross product

must_fail_controls.copied_bio_only_impostor: row where check1=False, check2_present=False, check2_identity_bound=False, check3=True -- verdict MUST be impostor
must_fail_controls.verification_without_further_evidence: row where check1=False, check2_present=True, check2_identity_bound=False, check3=False -- verdict MUST NOT be official
must_fail_controls.identity_blind_mark_plus_copied_bio: row where check1=False, check2_present=True, check2_identity_bound=False, check3=True -- verdict MUST NOT be official

rows.label: check1=False; check2 mark absent (not satisfied); check3=False (bio/domain match)
rows.reason: no check satisfied -- neither check1, nor a satisfied check2 (identity-bound verification), nor check3 (bio/domain match)

rows.label: check3-only: copied bio, no check1, no verification mark present at all
rows.reason: check3 (bio/self-description) is the only signal that holds -- check1 is False and check2 is not satisfied (no verification mark is present). Per the AND-clause, check3 ALONE is NOT sufficient and does not co-occur with check1 or a satisfied check2 here, so this account is REFUSED as not-official (impostor), never admitted on the forgeable check alone or on an identity-blind mark
